messages:
anya: Quick UX nits from today's design review — dropping them here for triage

anya: 1) Retention tooltip copy feels ambiguous: currently reads `Data retention: 30 days (encrypted at rest)`. Users are asking "where" data is stored and whether KMS applies to logs. Suggest: `Data retention: 30 days — stored in your selected region and encrypted at rest with your customer-managed KMS key (if configured).`

mike: good call. that clarifies region + KMS. can we keep it short for compact UIs? maybe remove parenthetical?

liz: prefer slightly shorter verbage for small screens: `30 days • stored in selected region • encrypted with your KMS` — use bullets/delimiter so it's scannable.

jordan: accessibility nit: the tooltip currently is not keyboard dismissible — pressing Esc doesn't close it, and focus isn't returned to the originating control. Also tab order jumps: retention dropdown -> Save -> KMS selector. Should be linear: region -> retention -> KMS -> save.

sam: noted. tabindex order is off because KMS panel is rendered later in DOM. I'll change the DOM order and re-run a11y tests. quick patch: add `aria-describedby` to retention control pointing at tooltip id.

kai: legal/security note: avoid acronym-only labels like "BYOK" without expansion. Use `Customer-managed key (KMS)` on first mention, then we can shorten to "KMS" elsewhere. Also audit log copy needs timestamps + key-id clarity.

anya: audit log example that confused support: `encryption key used: key-12345` — customer asked "which key, in which region?" Suggest `encryption key: key-12345 (kms://us-east-1/12345)` or `Key: key-12345 — KMS (us-east-1)`

liz: UI suggestion for audit log row: left column event text, right column metadata collapsed under chevron. display key-id + region in meta row. keeps primary message concise.

mike: dev question — do we have a canonical format for KMS URIs? sam?

sam: we don't currently. we should standardize to `kms://<region>/<key-id>` or `projects/<proj>/locations/<region>/keyRings/<ring>/cryptoKeys/<key>`. I'll add a short formatter in backend and expose `display_kms` to frontend.

jordan: for keyboard users the meta chevron must be focusable and announce expanded/collapsed via `aria-expanded`. also ensure the collapsed summary includes `Event occurred — details hidden` for screen readers.

design-bot: Reference: design system pattern for disclosure lists — https://internal.design/patterns/disclosure (contains aria patterns and example copy).

anya: tiny copy tweak: change "Encrypt at rest" label in Settings to "Encrypt stored data (at rest)" — users read "encrypt" as action rather than state.

mike: backlog items: 1) tooltip copy update (product) 2) KMS label wording change + audit log format (product + legal) 3) DOM/tab order + aria fixes (eng) 4) design pattern updates + small-screen copy throttling (design). I'll tag owners in the ticket.

liz: I'll prepare a condensed copy deck with mobile variants and submit to #design-review by EOD.

sam: I'll open a PR for tabindex/order + aria-describedby and link it here when ready.

kai: +1 on copy rules. I'll add a line to the compliance playbook to avoid unexpanded acronyms for security controls.

anya: thanks all — feel free to add any examples/screengrabs here. :thumbsup:
